This Mfa Filed U/S.74(1) Of Right To Fair Compensation
And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And
Resettlement Act, 2013., Against The Judgment And Order
Dated: 16.04.2022 Passed In Lac No.65/2018 On The File Of
The I Additional District And Sessions Judge, Ramanagara,
Partly Allowing The Reference Petition U/S.64 Of The Right
To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land
Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013.

This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:

Coram: Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Lalitha Kanneganti
 Oral Judgment
When this matter came up on 04.09.2024, as there was no representation on behalf of the appellant and this court had directed the matter to be listed under the caption for 'dismissal' on 12.09.2024.
Today when the matter came up there is no representation on behalf of the appellant.
It appears that the appellant is not interested to pursue the matter.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.

SD/-
(LALITHA KANNEGANTI) JUDGE The Managing Director vs Chandrashekara on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63490514/
